definition: Mamba is a deep learning architecture focused on sequence modeling.
details: It was developed by two researchers Albert Gu from Carnegie Mellon University and Tri Dao from Princeton University to address some limitations of transformer models, especially in processing long sequences, and it is based on the Structured State Space sequence (S4) model.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Mamba (deep learning architecture) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
